name: io.github.serac-labs/servicenow-mcp
title: Serac ServiceNow
description: 400+ ServiceNow tools over stdio or streamable HTTP, plus blast-radius impact analysis

environmentVariables.name: SNOW_INSTANCE
environmentVariables.description: ServiceNow instance, e.g. dev12345.service-now.com. SERVICENOW_INSTANCE_URL is also read.

environmentVariables.name: SNOW_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of an OAuth entry under System OAuth > Application Registry on the instance.

environmentVariables.name: SNOW_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret of that same OAuth application registry entry.

environmentVariables.name: SNOW_LAZY_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: false registers all tools up front. Default defers them behind tool_search/tool_execute.
